summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of an Argentine relevant-event notice to the CNV, BYMA and MAE) announcing the cancellation by operation of law of 2,299,993 treasury ordinary shares. The shares were acquired between September 8 and October 11, 2023 under the August 24, 2023 buyback plan; having remained in treasury three years without shareholder-meeting resolution on their destination, Article 67 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 mandated cancellation. Post-cancellation capital is ARS 1,511,470,229 across the same number of ARS 1 par shares; the board will register the reduction. Watch only for registry registration and any technical index effects on float.
